=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text per ": additive persistence "
text dr ", digital root "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note a ulong has at most 20 digits
fn dsum n ulong to ulong
s = ulong 0
v = n
while gt v 0 bound 20
s = add s rem v 10
v = div v 10
end
ret s
end
note bound: one digit sum takes any ulong below 181, the next below 19, then a single digit, so 4 rounds suffice
fn tell n ulong to void
v = n
p = ulong 0
while gt v 9 bound 4
v = dsum v
p = add p 1
end
emitu n
emit per
emitu p
emit dr
emitu v
emit nl
end
fn main to int
tell 627615
tell 39390
tell 588225
tell 393900588225
tell 0
tell 9
tell 199
tell 18446744073709551615
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
627615: additive persistence 2, digital root 9
39390: additive persistence 2, digital root 6
588225: additive persistence 2, digital root 3
393900588225: additive persistence 2, digital root 9
0: additive persistence 0, digital root 0
9: additive persistence 0, digital root 9
199: additive persistence 3, digital root 1
18446744073709551615: additive persistence 3, digital root 6
</pre>
